source_snapshot.test_name_items: Upgrade and Downgrade BIOS firmware by Web when system is booted
source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    Upgrade / Downgrade BIOS firmware through web UI.

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.

deepseek_columns.ai_packages_needed: browser/automation to drive the BMC web-UI flash page + BIOS image (user provides)
deepseek_columns.ai_commands: -- BIOS upgrade/downgrade via the BMC web UI: the agent first places the exact user-provided BIOS image where the web-UIs upload control expects it, then drives the BIOS flash page (upload image, start update, wait for completion) with the SUT must be booted and the BMC web-UI reachable; after completion verify the BIOS version. Interactive web-UI upload is not a single sshpass one-liner; walk the UI steps after the image is in place.
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: return screenshots + the flash-completion status and the BIOS version shown before/after so the user confirms a successful flash and a clean single reset.
deepseek_columns.risk: RISK: BIOS firmware flash via web UI is state-changing and can brick the BMC/host if interrupted; flash only the user-specified image and do not interrupt mid-flash.

historical_reviews.deepseek: PARTIAL; recognizes attended WebUI flashing but adds a single-reset expectation absent from the source.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: BLOCKED / CHANGED; treats missing project versions/criteria/recovery as a semantic block.
historical_reviews.round_02: YES; entry 714/2291 retains WebUI operation and supporting verification.

original_test_intent: Perform owner-approved BIOS firmware upgrade and downgrade through the BMC WebUI while the host is booted and demonstrate successful image acceptance, activation, expected BIOS version, POST/boot health and required settings behavior.
original_method: A human selects/uploads/commits each approved BIOS image in the WebUI, observes progress and reboot/activation, then independent read-only tools verify BIOS identity, POST/OS/BMC health and protected settings.
manual_activity: The source explicitly uses BMC WebUI upload/confirmation/progress for a destructive BIOS write; those acceptance-critical UI actions are manual. Agent support is evidence preparation and independent verification.
required_inputs: Verified BIOS image identities and platform matrix
Stable power, console/OOB and recovery image/process
safety_requirements: One authorized image/transition at a time; do not retry or reverse after an uncertain result.
Verify signature/hash and board compatibility before the operator opens the write action.
Require stable power and tested recovery; preserve baseline BIOS settings and raw failures.
Do not assume DeepSeek's added single reset because it is not in the source.
agent_execution_scope: Prepare image and compatibility evidence, collect pre/post BIOS/BMC/host/SEL/settings data and compare the approved plan with observed results.
Do not drive or claim completion of the WebUI flash or issue the formal verdict.
engineer_actions: Approve the transition plan/recovery and manually perform each WebUI image selection, confirmation and progress observation.
Assess POST/settings behavior and issue separate upgrade/downgrade verdicts.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Its workflow shape is relevant, but browser automation cannot replace the manual WebUI core under V3.1 and the clean-single-reset statement is unsupported by the master row.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use the vendor WebUI procedure manually; use the existing read-only version script and independent BIOS/BMC/host evidence afterward.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The booted-host WebUI method, script and 5/30-minute values remain; project versions and policy are approved overrides.

modernized_recommendation.status: ATTENDED WEBUI BIOS TRANSITION WITH INDEPENDENT VERIFICATION
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Bind each manual WebUI transition to an immutable image and approval, record the UI/activation timeline and independently verify active version, POST/boot and protected settings.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: BMC/BIOS pair supporting the vendor WebUI BIOS update workflow.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record BIOS/BMC, WebUI/browser, image and verification-tool versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Vendor WebUI BIOS update/recovery documentation and approved release matrix.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds version/image traceability, settings/health evidence and recovery gates without replacing the WebUI.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Distinguishes upload banner from successful activation and healthy boot, and detects collateral settings changes.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A successful WebUI banner is insufficient; recovery must be available before each write.

project_override_considerations: Projects may define exact images, order, reboot and preservation criteria; execution completion applies only to that unchanged approved plan and does not claim other version pairs.
expected_evidence: Complete manual WebUI screenshots/transcript and activation timeline
Independent post-transition BIOS version, POST/boot and protected-settings evidence

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The intent and WebUI method are clear; exact versions and observable project success criteria are required project inputs, not a source contradiction. The extra single-reset claim is a historical overlay and is rejected.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Under the locked Master Library rule, missing project versions/recovery details do not create permanent BLOCKED. The manual WebUI core makes this MANUAL ONLY once inputs are approved.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Retains attended WebUI scope but rejects invented reset semantics and browser substitution.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Restores executability under approved project inputs while preserving all safety/recovery gates; changes BLOCKED to MANUAL ONLY.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Applies the locked rule that project parameters and recovery package affect readiness, not automation capability or permanent block.

review_improvement: Allows safe project-specific execution without inventing a global version matrix, while preventing a UI banner from being treated as proof of activated, bootable BIOS firmware.
independent_technical_reasoning: The test method and direction are intelligible; exact images and activation policy are normal project plan inputs. Because the destructive interaction and primary progress observation occur in WebUI, core acceptance remains manual rather than blocked.
